title: GPU resupply bucketization & transit-slack sheet
body:
Purpose:
Quick operational sheet to bucketize incoming GPU supply into lanes by lead-time volatility and transit slack, and to recommend immediate order cadence changes for Q1-Q2 2025. This is intentionally pragmatic — we want a compact decision surface for on-call and infra procurement to triage orders when transport windows move or supplier ETAs slip.

Executive summary:
- Current problem: several mid-Q1 shipments have seen ETA variance of 7–21 days; our regional staging buffers are uneven (US-WEST strong, EU weak).
- Proposal: classify incoming orders into three buckets (Immediate Resupply, Flexible Transit, Strategic Staging) and attach a transit-slack metric + contingency action per bucket.
- Goal: reduce emergency spot-lease events by 40% and avoid expensive cross-region lift for 8 weeks.

Assumptions and inputs (quick):
- Demand baseline: token-inference capacity growth ~12% month-over-month (internal forecast v3).
- Typical lead-times by supplier: OEM-A 14–35d, OEM-B 7–21d, Brokers ~3–60d (high variance).
- Transit slack defined = (planned ETA margin days) - (lead-time volatility percentile buffer). Positive = healthy; negative = risky.

Bucket definitions:
1) Immediate Resupply (IR): ETA <= 21d and transit_slack <= 7d. Action: prioritize customs and expedited trucking; if slack <= 0, run emergency spot-lease plan.
2) Flexible Transit (FT): ETA 22–60d and transit_slack >= 10d. Action: move to poolable cross-region staging; consider consolidation shipping for cost savings.
3) Strategic Staging (SS): ETA > 60d or long tail broker orders. Action: treat as runway replenishment; do not rely for near-term SLOs.

Simple risk math examples:
- If EU-WEST H100 order transit_slack = -2 and projected EU demand growth = +15% in 4w, probability of backfill need (cross-region move) estimated ~0.62 => recommend start broker negotiation now.
- For A100-80GB-SXM4 in APAC with ETA 72d and volatility tail 28d => treat as SS and schedule secondary order with OEM-A for 30d lead lane to avoid >90% shortfall risk.

Recommended immediate actions (next 14 days):
- Trigger expedited customs lane for US-WEST H100X shipments where slack <= 7d (Ops: Diego).
- Open 2 short-term spot-lease windows for APAC in case A100 backlog slips beyond +10d (Finance pre-approve cap $120k).
- Convert 40% of FT bucket shipments to consolidated freight if carrier rebate >= 6% (Logistics: Hannah).

Medium-run cadence (30–90d):
- Rebalance staging across US-WEST and EU-NORTH by moving 12 A800 units from US-WEST FT pool to EU-NORTH pooled reserve once A800-48GB shipments confirm.
- Run an experiment: stagger 3 deliveries per OEM-A order instead of single full shipment to reduce single-ETA exposure. Track ETA variance pre/post.

Triggers, thresholds and on-call runbook (short):
- Trigger A (ETA variance > 14d for IR bucket): Infra on-call + Procurement 1h sync; escalate to SRE lead if cross-region move required.
- Trigger B (TransitSlack <= 0 and committed > 5 units): Execute emergency spot-lease playbook and notify GTM for capacity impact comms.
- Trigger C (Broker orders aging > 45d): Procurement to swap to OEM lane if penalty acceptable.

Experiment proposals (Q1):
- Staggered fulfilment pilot with OEM-A: split upcoming 60-unit purchase into 3x20 shipments across 6 weeks. Measure variance and cost delta.
- Transit-insurance A/B test: purchase insurance on 20% of high-value lanes to see if claim recovery offsets premium.

Open questions and notes to procurement:
- Do we have appetite to pay 8–10% premium for guaranteed 30d lanes in exchange for 0 variance?
- Confirm customs brokerage budget for expedited handling in EU ports for Feb–Mar surge window.

Next steps and owners:
- Diego: open expedited customs docket for US-WEST H100X shipments (due 2025-02-21).
- Hannah: confirm consolidation savings rate with Carrier-X by 2025-02-25.
- Marcus: run EU demand stress test with Product telemetry by 2025-02-24.
